title: Closing thanks
summary: Brown thanks him and the interview ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Bobby Hutcherson, thank you so very much for spending this time with us, so that we could try to capture some of the humanity and the greatness and the love and the music and all that you’ve done to make America, to make our lives, to make this music, a force for good.
We did pretty good, didn’t we?
